page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-8x.32xlarge is an accelerator-focused instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM hypervisor virtualization and x86_64 architecture, the platform features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. System memory totals 512.0 GB, maintaining an allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by eight discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs providing a combined 192 GB of VRAM, with 24 GB allocated per graphics processing unit. The instance incorporates high-throughput networking with a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with this configuration, meaning non-volatile file systems and data persistence depend entirely on network-attached storage volumes. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The dense integration of eight enterprise GPUs alongside 128 dedicated host cores delivers substantial parallel compute throughput. The absence of local disk drives requires consideration of network storage latency, but the 64 Gbps network interface helps facilitate large data transfers. This hardware profile is engineered primarily for multi-stream AI inference, distributed model serving, cloud rendering pipelines, and high-performance graphics workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-8x.32xlarge is an accelerator-oriented instance from the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM virtualization and x86_64 architecture, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors at 2.9 GHz, alongside 512.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by 8 NVIDIA A10 GPUs delivering 192 GB of total VRAM, with 24 GB per GPU. Network interfaces operate with a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The configuration includes no local storage, relying on external network storage solutions, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio and substantial multi-GPU capacity, this server is configured for distributed deep learning inference, real-time video transcoding, 3D rendering pipelines, and demanding parallel computing tasks.
